title: South-East Development Commission (Establishment) Act, 2024
gazette_number: Federal Republic of Nigeria Official Gazette / Act No. 6 of 2024
description: An Act to establish the South-East Development Commission charged with the responsibility for the reconstruction, rehabilitation, and infrastructural development of the South-East zone.

sections.section_title: Establishment of the South-East Development Commission
sections.part: Part I - Establishment of the Commission and the Governing Board
sections.full_text:
(1) There is established the South-East Development Commission (in this Act referred to as "the Commission").
(2) The Commission is a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal and may sue and be sued in its corporate name.
sections.searchable_chunk:
South-East Development Commission (Establishment) Act, 2024 - Section 1: Establishment of the South-East Development Commission
Part I - Establishment of the Commission and the Governing Board
(1) There is established the South-East Development Commission (in this Act referred to as "the Commission").
(2) The Commission is a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal and may sue and be sued in its corporate name.

sections.part: Part I - Establishment of the Commission and the Governing Board
sections.full_text:
(1) There is established for the Commission, a Governing Board (in this Act referred to as "the Board").
(2) The Board shall consist of a Chairman, one person each from the South-East States (Abia, Anambra, Ebonyi, Enugu, Imo), security representatives, and executive management.

sections.full_text: The Commission shall formulate policies, plan and implement infrastructural, economic, educational, and ecological reconstruction projects across the South-East zone.
